import re

def format_price(price):
    dollars, cents = price.split('.')
    formatted_dollars = ''
    while dollars:
        formatted_dollars = '.' + dollars[-3:] + formatted_dollars if len(dollars) > 3 else dollars + formatted_dollars
        dollars = dollars[:-3]
    return formatted_dollars.lstrip('.') + '.' + cents.zfill(2)

def main():
    s = input().strip()
    prices = re.findall(r'([a-z]+)(\d+(\.\d{2})?)', s)
    total_price = sum(float(price) for _, price in prices)
    formatted_total_price = format_price(str(total_price))
    print(formatted_total_price)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
